name: 寒霜狼
subject: A natural FROST WOLF, complete four-legged anatomy and bushy tail, off-white and silver-grey winter coat, desaturated icy blue shadow, a few tiny frost crystals along shoulder fur, pale amber eyes.

name: 雪原巨熊
subject: A powerful SNOW BEAR, thick cream-white winter fur, dark grey paws and nose, massive shoulders, complete four legs and small round ears; old tan scars, no clothing or weapons.

name: 冰原史萊姆
subject: An ICEFIELD SLIME, squat translucent glacial-cyan gel, milky white inner frost nucleus, irregular frozen droplet crest, dark teal slit eyes and subtle lavender shadow. No limbs or cartoon smile.

name: 雷電魔像
subject: A LIGHTNING GOLEM, full heavy body made of slate-violet rock plates around a muted amber electric core, two thick arms and two jointed stone legs; a few connected golden conductive cracks.
